response.sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(a.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(a.track_count) AS avg_track_count, AVG(a.rate - o.mean_rate) AS avg_excess FROM album_rates a CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE a.rate > o.mean_rate

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with NULL AlbumId form one group (GROUP BY puts NULLs together), as the request states.
Track count is the count of all tracks in the album, including tracks with NULL Bytes; only the rate average ignores missing sizes.
Bytes is cast to REAL to avoid integer division. Milliseconds is NOT NULL, and is assumed non-zero.
Albums where every track has NULL Bytes have a NULL rate. They are included in neither the overall mean nor the above-mean set.

alternatives.interpretation: Track count only counts tracks with non-missing Bytes (the tracks that contribute to the rate).
